security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI RNMI context save/restore handler reads or writes mnstatus.MNPV (bit 7) in the saved mnstatus CSR value on a hart that does not implement the H extension, treating the reserved bit as meaningful virtualization state
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: context switching|trap handler with MNRET restore that does not check misa.H before extracting/setting MNPV; unconditional bitwise copy of whole mnstatus instead of field-by-field with H-extension gating on MNPV
security_spec.summary: OpenSBI must condition MNPV save/restore in RNMI context switching on misa.H — unconditionally restoring a stale MNPV bit on a no-H hart causes MNRET to restore an incorrect virtualization mode (reserved bit silently accepted), breaking the architectural invariant that harts without H extension always execute with V=0
